what_happened: Task description names FormalSystem/PlusLanguage/Substitution.lean as the home of the ZTime-validity -> TM-plus bridge, but that module is layer 0 in LANGUAGE_FILE_LAYERS (scripts/measure-refactor-partitions.py). Measured: adding 'import FormalSystem.Metalogic.StrongCompleteness' makes scripts/check-metalogic-cycles.sh Assertion B fail (SURPLUS upward edge, exit 1); adding 'import FormalSystem.Semantics.Validity' fails both Assertion B (SURPLUS) and Assertion C (SYNTAX->SEMANTICS), exit 1. Baseline gate exit 0. The bridge must be sited in a Metalogic (layer 3) module instead.

Both deliverables of the task compile sorry-free on the first attempt via lean_run_code: the two-step bridge (completeness_ztime then plusDerivable_substPlus_nil) and the box-free linear corollary (a new wordOf + truthAt_iff_intTruth_of_boxFree induction, then validZTime_iff_validInt). Measured axiom profile [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] = the repo's 'pcq' baseline, no sorryAx. Research therefore hands the planner fully compiled proof bodies rather than sketches, and the host-module import set was gate-verified (check-metalogic-cycles.sh exit 0) before being recommended.

Task description names FormalSystem/PlusLanguage/Substitution.lean as the bridge's home; research measured that siting as gate-blocked (check-metalogic-cycles.sh Assertions B and C, exit 1). The plan therefore sites the bridge in a new Metalogic-root module and drops Substitution.lean from file scope, diverging from the description's named location by design.

The research report carried both headline proof bodies already compiled (lean_run_code, axiom profile pcq, no sorryAx) plus three gate-measured siting probes. Plan authoring reduced to transcription, siting and gate-bookkeeping decomposition; no fresh Lean discovery was needed and no tactic search was re-run.

Task 900's description cites Reynolds 2001 Lemma 7 / 17 / 23, which brushes against ROADMAP.md's standing ruling barring Lean formalization of any part of Reynolds 2001 SS7-15. Resolved by reading ROADMAP.md rather than escalating: the same file names 900 as item 9 of 879's ingredient table (the 'linear bridge'), explicitly sanctioned in its own dispatch line, so no user_decision was raised.

Phase 1 scope hypothesis confirmed exactly as the plan predicted: grep -rn isBoxFree over FormalSystem/ and Tests/ returned exactly one prose cross-reference outside the two Separation files (PlusLanguage/Subformulas.lean:270) and exactly one importer of Separation.SemanticBridge (KampTranslation.lean). No widening of the phase file list was needed, the relocation landed as a clean +11/-11 verbatim move, and both the scoped three-module build and the whole-project build (2974 jobs) were green on the first attempt with zero errors and zero warnings. typst-sync-check --counts-only reported no drift, so the plan's conditional status.typ regeneration was correctly not triggered.

The harness moved the phase-end full lake build to the background after 180s even though the Bash tool timeout parameter was explicitly raised to 600000ms and the canonical bounded-waiter idiom (captured pid, kill -0 liveness loop, outer timeout 3000) was used inside a single call. The auto-background threshold appears to be lower than the documented 600s foreground ceiling that long-builds.md's preference order assumes, which forces the dispatch into the notification path that bounded-build-waiter.md's symptom 2 warns against. Mitigation applied: the completion notification carried exit code 0 and the guard's own STATUS line plus the captured log were re-read to establish the verdict across all three tiers of long-builds.md 'Reading the build's verdict', so no verdict was taken on trust.

Plan Risks-table counterexample for the load-bearing isBoxFree hypothesis is arithmetically backwards: IntTruth W t (box bot -> bot) unfolds to True -> False = False, so it does NOT hold on every word. The correct witness is box bot alone: IntTruth gives True everywhere while TruthAt gives forall sigma, False, so box bot is not ValidZTime. Module docstring states the corrected witness; no signature or hypothesis changed.
